address: Mandarin Oriental Hotel, 48 Soi Charoen Krung 40, Charoen Krung Road, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: The original owner of this 120-year-old heritage house served the government as Phraya, one of the highest ranks of Thai nobility. Previously Mandarin Oriental's cooking school, they switched operations in 2022. Chef Patchara serves traditional Thai dishes inspired by those school recipes. Surrounded by shady greens, the whitewashed house has a terrace with stunning sunset views over the river. The dining room inside fits a capacity of 20 guests a night....
